def test_same_chars():
    # Identical strings
    assert same_chars("hello", "hello") is True
    
    # Same characters, different order
    assert same_chars("abc", "cba") is True
    assert same_chars("listen", "silent") is True
    
    # Repeated characters, same underlying set
    assert same_chars("aabbcc", "abc") is True
    assert same_chars("aaa", "aaaaaa") is True
    
    # Different character sets
    assert same_chars("abc", "abd") is False
    assert same_chars("abcd", "abc") is False
    
    # Both empty strings
    assert same_chars("", "") is True
    
    # One empty string
    assert same_chars("", "a") is False
    assert same_chars("a", "") is False
    
    # Case sensitivity
    assert same_chars("abc", "ABC") is False
    assert same_chars("AbC", "CaB") is True
    
    # Single characters
    assert same_chars("x", "x") is True
    assert same_chars("x", "y") is False
    
    # Strings with spaces and special characters
    assert same_chars("a b!", "!ba ") is True
    assert same_chars("a b", "ab") is False
    
    # Digits mixed with letters
    assert same_chars("123abc", "abc321") is True
    assert same_chars("12", "123") is False
    
    # Unicode characters
    assert same_chars("héllo", "olléh") is True
    assert same_chars("café", "facé") is True
    
    # Superset/subset relationships
    assert same_chars("aabbbcccc", "abc") is True
    assert same_chars("aab", "abb") is True  # same set {a, b}
    assert same_chars("aab", "abbc") is False
